pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Asymmetric polygonal patches with variable edge angularity; larger regions on the neck exhibit higher edge contrast and sharper gradients compared to the smaller, more rounded patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, cream-colored topological web with well-defined junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the midsection, forming a clear geometric lattice.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane along the cervical ridge showing a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Visual discontinuities in the mane silhouette caused by the occlusion of three perched birds on the dorsal line.

other_distinctive_markers: Three small dark birds (oxpeckers) are perched on the upper neck and dorsal ridge, acting as external visual features not part of the giraffe anatomy.
